title: Retain the exact authorized Work Queue page when selecting its Incident or Task
goal: Fix a reproducible Case/Task selection regression: a row selected beyond page one must keep its current authorized cursor, while manual filter/sort changes start a new first-page query.
invariants: Single first-party GET /command/work-queue route; six views unchanged.
Manual filter/sort submission deliberately resets first page. Each row's separate read-only selection GET carries the currently authorized page cursor and current view/status/sort.
Selection ID is a hint only: new host session and complete current Owner.List/Owner.CanRead before selection; denied, revoked, off-page and stale cursor always fail generically without row data.
No new authorization engine, Trusted Base, external UI or DB. Git parent PR #166 is not work parent.
security_properties: All row selection navigation revalidates tenant/environment/principal through host session and each in-scope owner item.
Never trust hidden HTML cursor, scope or object ID as authorization.
Owner-controlled identifier and cursor are template escaped; query routing and action remain same-origin.

migration.rationale: Browser-only form isolation and current page presentation; JSON and provider contracts unchanged.

rollback.strategy: Remove per-row cursor-preserving selection form, retain owner cursor validation and existing selection APIs.
verification: Legacy JSON/forward and backward pagination pass unchanged

inputs: PR #166 HEAD 47ecdc1809769624ea1f37a4710336f48ba96301 CI command-work-queue-runtime and engineering-kernel SUCCESS.
HTML selected button currently shares filter form and omits cursor, resulting in page reset/404 beyond first page.
outputs: A selection on page 2/3 returns same currently authorized page and selected source row via existing route.
Manual changed status/sort/view never accidentally inherits stale page cursor.
Expired/revoked cursor and off-page IDs continue to return generic deny.
acceptance_tests: Build a 123-row fully authorized fixture: choose a row on page 3 via its native browser form, verify exact selected row/page and preserved view/status/sort.
Changing manual filters or sort from page 3 makes a fresh first-page request, not a stale cursor.
After ACL revocation prior page selection denies; forged off-page or stale cursor denies without source content.
Existing browser XSS and six-views tests plus Linux/macOS/Windows and mandatory >=90% changed critical security coverage green on exact HEAD.

performance_budget.rationale: No new owner calls or pagination passes; one existing O(n) <=5000 owner authorization per selected row.
metrics: One existing Owner.List per request and CanRead for in-scope rows

definition_of_ready: Exact parent PR #166 frozen SHA and its exact-head CI green.
One bounded Command Work Queue context, class-0 reading only, no OPEN decision needed.
definition_of_done: Real native selection from later pages works without a second authority or route, and manual filters reset predictably.
Exact-head mandatory GitHub CI passes; targeted L2 independent read-only review after material regression fix.
Only task IMPLEMENTED, not full CAP-CMD-101 or main delivery.
